title: Legal Research Methodology And Project Writing I
modules: History Of Legal Research In Nigeria
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a research into law as it stands in the books, it is speculative in nature."
Doctrinal research is a research into law as it stands in the books, it is speculative in nature.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a book of words grouped by ideas."
A thesaurus is a book of words grouped by ideas.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an integrated and organized discussion of the literature pertaining to a well- defined subject."
A review is an integrated and organized discussion of the literature pertaining to a well- defined subject.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a skill that requires constant practice and a certain amount of incentive to do better."
Reading is a skill that requires constant practice and a certain amount of incentive to do better.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the two vital components of research report."
Originality and clarity are the two vital components of research report.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered as one of the basic components of research."
Interpretation of data Interpretation is considered as one of the basic components of research.
fib: ______ is the process of arranging data in groups or classes according to their resemblance or affinity.
Classification or categorization of data is the process of arranging data in groups or classes according to their resemblance or affinity.
______ is the research of the actual working of the law in society in relation with other interdependent factors.
Non-doctrinal Research Non-doctrinal research is the research of the actual working of the law in society in relation with other interdependent factors.
______ is the conceptual structure within which research is conducted.
Research design is the conceptual structure within which research is conducted.
______ is a book of information in the form of condensed articles on every subject.
Encyclopaedia is a book of information in the form of condensed articles on every subject.
______ is a means of recording classification in a compact form in such a way to facilitate comparisons and show the involved relations between two or more variables.
Tabulation is a means of recording classification in a compact form in such a way to facilitate comparisons and show the involved relations between two or more variables.
______ is the case of conference papers.
Similar is the case of conference papers.
